assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The public repository does not provide official SITE_BOUNDARY or the three official KEY_AREA polygons.
assumptions.impact: All nine GeoJSON layers and geometry-derived metrics are provisional design-model evidence and must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: The earlier concept model was approximately 0.012 degrees east of the AMap/OSM position audit. ALIGN-V12-20260825 applies one controlled westward realignment to all nine submission layers.
assumptions.impact: Relative topology and areas are preserved while the park corridor is brought into alignment with verified local anchors; this does not convert provisional geometry into an official survey.

assumptions.statement: PROV-KEY-002 is a 104.3 ha area-equivalent 24-sided research envelope centred on the verified Origin Building, park and Wudaokou relationship; it does not infer the community boundary.
assumptions.impact: It satisfies the formal package requirement for three key-area polygons but is suppressed from maps and cannot support parcel, ownership, redline or engineering claims.

assumptions.statement: AMap anchors are GCJ-02; OSM park features began as WGS84 and were converted to GCJ-02 for the position-control overlay.
assumptions.impact: Coordinates are suitable for conceptual visual alignment only. Survey, CAD and statutory GIS must replace them before professional implementation.

assumptions.statement: Generated imagery may influence palette, atmosphere and hierarchy but cannot define roads, labels, boundaries, quantities or observed site conditions.
assumptions.impact: Any generated geography is rejected; final factual overlays are rebuilt from registered local data and deterministic scripts.

assumptions.statement: Programs, funding pathways, operators, events, procurement and international partnerships are proposed mechanisms, not confirmed government or corporate commitments.
assumptions.impact: Every pilot requires a named future owner, approval, risk review and stop condition before launch.
